media:content.media:text: State backpacks come in an array of designs for boys and girls, but this metallic purple with butterflies was the clear winner for my 5-year-old.
media:content.media:description: After asking a number of parents for recommendations, an overwhelming number of them recommended a State backpack.

media:content.media:text: Calpak’s Miffy backpack had a cute bunny design, but I loved the fit most. The straps are super padded, and the sternum clip kept it secure on my daughter’s back.

media:content.media:text: This was the largest backpack we tested, making it a great option for taking kids from kindergarten to older grades, when they’ll need to carry more books and homework.
media:content.media:description: After asking a number of parents for recommendations, an overwhelming number of them recommended a State backpack.

media:content.media:text: I found this backpack easy to wipe down, which was a major win. It is also slightly smaller, making it a good option for petite kids.
media:content.media:description: After asking a number of parents for recommendations, an overwhelming number of them recommended a State backpack.

media:content.media:text: The interior pockets make this backpack a winner from an organizational standpoint — it has tons of pockets and sleeves to keep things tidy.
